title: Antiparallel Strands
text: DNA and RNA strands are antiparallel. If the template is 3' to 5', the mRNA will be 5' to 3'. RNA polymerase always synthesizes in the 5' to 3' direction.

title: Step-by-Step Conversion
text: T->A, A->U, C->G, G->C, G->C, A->U, T->A, C->G, A->U, A->U, T->A, T->A gives AUGCCUAGUUAA.
